prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on your business, goals, budget, industry and the services you need. I can help you find the best fit. A quick way to proceed is:

1) Quick questions so I can tailor recommendations
- What industry are you in (B2B, B2C, ecommerce, healthcare, home services, etc.)?
- What services do you need (SEO, PPC, social media, content, branding, website/app, full-service)?
- Monthly/annual budget range for marketing?
- Company size and geography you serve (local Maryland customers, regional, national)?
- Any timeline or KPIs (lead volume, revenue targets, brand awareness)?

2) How I’ll evaluate agencies for you
- Relevant industry experience and case studies
- Measurable results (ROI, leads, traffic improvements)
- Client retention and references
- Team structure and communication style
- Pricing model and contract flexibility
- Reviews on Clutch/G2/Google + portfolio quality

3) Examples of well-regarded Maryland agencies (to give you an idea)
- Blue Corona (Gaithersburg area) — known for performance-driven digital marketing for SMBs and home/services industries.
- Modea (Baltimore) — established web design/development/digital agency with strong UX and technical chops.

If you want, tell me the answers to the quick questions above and I’ll shortlist 4–6 Maryland agencies that match your needs, with pros/cons, expected budget ranges, and suggested questions to ask them.
